home.footer: Unofficial fan app. You need your own copy of Sail.
home.title: Play Sail solo.
home.lead: The Bosun takes the other side of the ship. You flip its cards; the app keeps the tricks, the Kraken and the storms.
home.how1: Set up Sail as usual and pick a difficulty.
home.how2: Each trick, the app tells you how the Bosun plays.
home.how3: Tap the winner and the symbols: you get the order.

setup.line1: Assemble the ocean board. Put the play area and Kraken boards at opposite ends.
setup.line3: {pirates, select, easy {Pirate cards: two, shared, beside the board.} easyCw {Pirate cards: two, shared, beside the board; one is the Cannon + Wheel.} mediumCw {Pirate cards: one for you, the Cannon + Wheel for the Bosun.} hard {Pirate card: one for you. The Bosun has none.} other {Pirate cards: one for you, one for the Bosun.}}
setup.line4: Kraken on its lowest left space, the 3. Trick cubes on 0.
setup.line5: Round disc on I, on your side: you lead the first trick.
setup.line7: Kraken deck: the six 1s and 2s shuffled, face up, the Kraken card at the bottom.
setup.line8: Player deck: the 3s to 9s shuffled, face down.
setup.line9: Deal 9 cards to yourself and 9 face down to the Bosun’s stack. Don’t look at its cards.

game.exchangeSub: No talking from the deal to the last trick. The Bosun never talks anyway.
game.exchange1: Pick a card to give the Bosun. Put it aside, face down.
game.exchange2: Take the Bosun’s top card into your hand.
game.exchange3: Put your card face down on top of its stack. Now you know its first card.
game.exchangeTip: Sail Solitaire, Play: the Bosun gives you the top card of its stack; the card you give goes on top of its stack.

trick.title: {side, select, you {TRICK {n} · YOU LEAD} other {TRICK {n} · THE BOSUN LEADS}}
trick.follow1: Play a card from your hand.
trick.follow2: Flip the Bosun’s cards from the top, one by one, until one matches your colour. It plays that card.
trick.follow3: None matches? Pick any of its cards for it: they’re all face up now.
trick.follow4: Turn the other flipped cards face down. Put them back on its stack in the same order.
trick.followPeek: You may study the flipped cards before you turn them back.
trick.lead1: Flip the Bosun’s top card. It leads with it.
trick.lead2: Play a card: follow its colour if you can.
trick.foldFollow: Flip the Bosun’s cards until one follows your colour.
trick.foldLead: Flip the Bosun’s top card: it leads. Follow its colour if you can.
trick.whoHint: The highest card in the colour led.

combos.title: THE COMBOS
combos.lead: Match the symbols of the two cards in the trick. The winner’s side sets the direction.
combos.r2: Forward, toward the winner. The Kraken attacks once.
combos.r3: Forward, toward the winner. The Kraken attacks twice.
combos.r4: Hit the Kraken: the Helm & Kraken card goes under the Kraken deck.
combos.r6: Flip the player deck’s top card and do its cannon action.
combos.r7: Anything else: no action, no attack.
combos.c2: This card goes under the Kraken deck.

cannonWheel.title: THE BOSUN’S CANNON + WHEEL
cannonWheel.lead: Sail Solitaire’s special note, step by step.
cannonWheel.s1: Pick the Bosun’s new card from the player deck and set it aside.
cannonWheel.s3: Put the Bosun’s top card face down on the player deck.
cannonWheel.s4: Put the set-aside card on top of the Bosun’s stack.
